product: Velocity — a zero-infrastructure, single-file HTML+JS portfolio/delivery management app for running data-analytics projects across multiple customer accounts (client-side, localStorage-persisted, optional provider-agnostic AI layer).
primaryGoal: Let a delivery lead plan, allocate, and govern a multi-customer project portfolio (and produce the governed documents/quotes that flow from it) with zero setup and no data leaving the browser.

commandNotes.lint: No linter configured — zero-dependency single-file app.
commandNotes.typecheck: No TypeScript in the app itself; only the Playwright config is .ts.
commandNotes.build: No bundling. The only 'build' step is mirroring authored definitions/ into index.html data islands via scripts/embed-definitions.mjs; run it after editing anything under definitions/.
commandNotes.test: vitest run — 224 unit + render specs under tests/unit and tests/render (jsdom via tests/harness/loadApp.mjs).
commandNotes.e2e: playwright test — 32 chromium specs under tests/e2e; serves index.html on 127.0.0.1:8765.
commandNotes.run: python3 -m http.server 8000 (or simply open index.html directly — file:// safe).

outOfBounds: Billing & cost math — settings.rate_card, settings.billing (rate_table/hours_per_point/customer_defaults), data.billing_arrangements, Billing.* (quoteForProject/customerSummary/plannedEconomics), and App.computeProjectCost. Do not change how money is calculated.

AI/Tableau credentials & key handling — AI provider profiles in localStorage (pcc_ai_settings), Tableau credentials (pcc_tableau_settings), and any code path that reads/writes/transports them. Provider keys must never reach App.data or exports.
Never push to or open PRs against main directly — the loop only lands on self-improve/staging.
Do not weaken the untrusted-content rules (Dashboard.esc usage, <untrusted_document>/<untrusted_external_data> wrapping).

setupNotes.emulatedSetup: This knowledge base was produced by manually executing the self-improve:setup playbook inside a Claude Code web session (the /plugin runtime is disabled on the web, so the slash commands could not register). Content is grounded in CLAUDE.md, package.json, the test configs, and the CI workflow.
setupNotes.stagingBranchDeferred: Per the session's branch policy, the self-improve/staging branch was NOT created/pushed here. Create it off main when you first run /self-improve:run in desktop/CLI.
